notes.title: 🛠️ SEX EXIT — Hotfix time!
notes.notes:
We have fixed an issue where the game controls could freeze or act weird after first cutscene.

Thanks to your feedback, we quickly tracked it down and patched it. Your reports really help us make the game better! 

Our team is working hard to make the gameplay as smooth and comfortable as possible — both technically and emotionally 😉

Update your game and get the full experience!

❤️ — OneHand Games Team
